taskCatalog.title: Review passport application and record an action
taskCatalog.description: Review immutable original evidence and any photo correction. Request a new photo, approve or deny with an individualized reason.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Compare the reason with retained original evidence and any separately accepted correction.

taskCatalog.title: Replace the requested passport photo
taskCatalog.description: Submit only a replacement photo linked to the original filing. Prior application answers remain visible through the qualified retained-evidence reader and cannot be edited by this task.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Compare the accepted replacement photo and original filing association.

taskCatalog.title: Respond to the outside-data notice
taskCatalog.description: Read source, time and result of the two explicit mock checks; dispute an adverse result within the separate 10-calendar-day sample period.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Retain the notice, qualifying sent receipt, response and reviewer reason; do not claim confirmation from unavailable data.

taskCatalog.title: Attach a late requested photo to the closed case
taskCatalog.description: Use the exact application Definition and retained original data. Accepting late evidence keeps the case closed and does not reopen it.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Retain late accepted response, source association, original answers and unchanged closed status.

taskCatalog.title: Record whether to reopen the closed case
taskCatalog.description: Jordan as an authorized Adjudicator records an individualized reason before reopening; no applicant or integration role may perform this decision.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Verify actual actor authority, completed reviewer task, nonblank reason and retained decision evidence.

taskCatalog.title: File an administrative reconsideration request
taskCatalog.description: D1 demonstration policy: actual retained original notice, attributable filing and independent current authorized human review are required.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Check the actual original proposal, qualified receipt, immutable filing deadline, actual assigned human and retained individual reasons.

taskCatalog.title: Independently reconsider the original decision
taskCatalog.description: D1 demonstration policy: actual retained original notice, attributable filing and independent current authorized human review are required.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Check the actual original proposal, qualified receipt, immutable filing deadline, actual assigned human and retained individual reasons.

taskCatalog.title: Review the accepted correction and retained original application
taskCatalog.description: Review immutable original evidence and any photo correction. Request a new photo, approve or deny with an individualized reason.
taskCatalog.verificationMethod: Compare the reason with retained original evidence and any separately accepted correction.
